standingInvitations.title: Council Meeting Speaker Request Form | Liverpool City Council
standingInvitations.method: Apply using the official form. Approved speakers have three minutes; Council allows at most five public forums, with one speaker for and one against each agenda item.
standingInvitations.timing: The application is due by noon two full business days before the meeting. The page does not state a timezone.
standingInvitations.eligibility: Only meeting-agenda matters. Repeat matters raised within twelve months need new information. Speakers must supply their name and comply with the meeting code.
standingInvitations.disclosure: Public forums are streamed and recorded, and speaker names appear in the minutes.
standingInvitations.verification: The current official speaker-request form instructions and recording notice were directly read on 7 November 2026. No form was completed.

standingInvitations.title: Public Question Time
standingInvitations.method: Attend an ordinary Council meeting, state your name and ask the chair; advance forms can be lodged with questiontime@hobartcity.com.au or at Council offices and receive priority.
standingInvitations.timing: Fifteen minutes total, three questions per person, sixty seconds for background and each question. Questions cannot concern items on that Council agenda; no debate. Chair may decline improper or advocacy-framed questions.
standingInvitations.eligibility: Fifteen minutes total, three questions per person, sixty seconds for background and each question. Questions cannot concern items on that Council agenda; no debate. Chair may decline improper or advocacy-framed questions.
standingInvitations.disclosure: Questioners consent to livestreaming. Written answers to questions on notice appear in a future agenda.
standingInvitations.verification: Official page directly read; it cites the 2025 meeting regulations.

standingInvitations.title: Request a deputation
standingInvitations.method: Use the linked online request form with delegation members, purpose and subject. CEO approval is required; committee deputations also require chair approval.
standingInvitations.timing: Committee deputations cover agenda items or relevant terms of reference, with at most three presenters sharing five minutes. Ordinary Council requests are written at least seven days before the meeting and cannot concern matters already programmed for that Council agenda.
standingInvitations.eligibility: Committee deputations cover agenda items or relevant terms of reference, with at most three presenters sharing five minutes. Ordinary Council requests are written at least seven days before the meeting and cannot concern matters already programmed for that Council agenda.
standingInvitations.disclosure: Accepted deputations are listed on the appropriate agenda. No deputation-specific confidentiality assurance was verified.
standingInvitations.verification: Official page directly read. Deputations are discretionary.

standingInvitations.title: Present a petition
standingInvitations.method: Use the linked petition form and comply with Part 6 and section 57 of the Local Government Act 1993, including electronic-petition requirements.
standingInvitations.timing: Generic online petition templates may not comply and may not be tabled.
standingInvitations.eligibility: Generic online petition templates may not comply and may not be tabled.
standingInvitations.disclosure: The Council explicitly warns that signatories' names, addresses and signatures are included in public agendas and meeting papers online.
standingInvitations.verification: Official page directly read.

standingInvitations.title: Public Question Time
standingInvitations.method: Use the Public Question Time form or ask a relevant question at a Council meeting. State your name and locality; questions are generally limited to two per person at Presiding Member discretion.
standingInvitations.timing: Written questions are encouraged by 4 pm on the preceding day to allow an informed response. This is not described as an absolute ban on questions without prior notice. Timezone is not expressly stated.
standingInvitations.eligibility: Questions must affect the Shire. At Special Council meetings, they must concern that meeting’s purpose. Committees listed on this page do not have delegated decision-making authority.
standingInvitations.disclosure: A summary of questions and answers may appear in the minutes.
standingInvitations.verification: Council-specific continuing procedure read 7 November 2026. Confirm the applicable meeting notice.

standingInvitations.title: Public Question Time
standingInvitations.method: Use the public-question form and follow its conditions. Ordinary Council meetings include question time. The separate monthly Q&A trial was discontinued from December 2025.
standingInvitations.timing: The form calls for at least twenty-four hours’ notice; research-heavy questions should arrive seven working days beforehand. A separate notice encourages questions the preceding day.
standingInvitations.eligibility: Questions must concern council business, functions or the Special Meeting’s purpose. Debate and discussion on answers are not permitted.
standingInvitations.disclosure: Accepted questions and responses are summarised in meeting minutes; rejected questions may be excluded.
standingInvitations.verification: Council-specific continuing procedure read 7 November 2026. Confirm the applicable meeting notice.

standingInvitations.title: Questions, petitions and deputations
standingInvitations.method: Use Public Question Time, submit a compliant petition, or request a deputation in writing to the CEO. The page provides a public-question form and the council-specific petition conditions.
standingInvitations.timing: For research-heavy questions, seven days’ advance notice is recommended. Deputation requests must arrive at least seven working days before the meeting.
standingInvitations.eligibility: Petitions are made by district electors with required names, addresses, signatures and signed dates. A deputation may have up to five people, with two addressing Council unless otherwise agreed.
standingInvitations.disclosure: Council meetings are audio-recorded except for confidential business; recordings are published following distribution of meeting minutes.
standingInvitations.verification: Council-specific continuing procedure read 7 November 2026. Confirm the applicable meeting notice.

standingInvitations.title: Annual Electors Meeting participation
standingInvitations.method: Attend the Annual Electors Meeting to discuss the annual report and general business, using its own notice and agenda.
standingInvitations.timing: The guide says an Annual Electors Meeting is held once each financial year and within fifty-six days after Council accepts the annual report. No new meeting date is verified here.
standingInvitations.eligibility: Only electors are entitled to participate. The council defines an elector as someone eligible to be enrolled to vote for the district or ward.
standingInvitations.disclosure: Recording and publication conditions specific to the Annual Electors Meeting were not confirmed on the reviewed guide.
standingInvitations.verification: Council-specific continuing procedure read 7 November 2026. Confirm the applicable meeting notice.

standingInvitations.eligibility: The public-question form requests name and address and questions affecting the Shire. The general guide describes petitions as signed by more than four people.
standingInvitations.verification: Council-specific continuing procedure read 7 November 2026. Confirm the applicable meeting notice.
